stem.text: In ‘normal driving conditions’, an electric car has a range of $150\,\text{km}$. This uses all of the $200\,\text{MJ}$ of energy stored in its batteries.

With the batteries initially fully charged, the car is driven $100\,\text{km}$ in ‘normal driving conditions’. The batteries are then recharged from a household electrical supply delivering a constant current of $13.0\,\text{A}$ at a potential difference of $230\,\text{V}$.
What is the minimum time required to recharge the batteries?
